cohort.historical_eligibility: per seed and k, malicious positive trees; benign negative trees; insufficient signs excluded
cohort.new_eligibility: same frozen population, both signs in each class; inputs replace trees; insufficient signs excluded

manuscript_inconsistency: 484 windows / 151 users / 242 positives / 242 negatives belongs to r4.2 in objective3_missing_source_robustness.py, not the r5.2 EDITOR-017/023 cohort. Claude clarified use of actual r5.2 cohort on 2026-10-21.

ig.targets: 8 raw tree outputs and final logit
ig.baseline: median over all original r5.2 TRAIN day rows per scaled feature, broadcast to all 20 days; paper intervention convention
ig.completeness: abs(sum(IG)-[f(x)-f(b)])/max(abs(f(x)-f(b)),1e-6); report per-target/class median, p95, absolute residual and near-zero counts

interventions.TA2_feature_unit: one of 13 raw features, summed signed IG over 20 days; replace all 20 days
interventions.XGBoost_feature_unit: one of 40 locked window summaries; replace summary with TRAIN median
interventions.raw_feature_sensitivity: XGBoost 40 summaries grouped to 13 raw features; replace all summaries in group
interventions.signs: positive and negative, separately, for every label stratum
interventions.random_control: 200 independent uniform subsets without replacement within subset, from same-sign eligible units; duplicates retained with multiplicity and scored once
interventions.directional_accuracy: strictly positive expected signed margin change; zero changes count as failures
interventions.normalization: population standard deviation (ddof=0) of each original model/seed over all 64000 validation logits/margins
interventions.physical_validity: local model-input interventions; derived constraints not recomputed; not a physical sensor-removal simulation

bootstrap.ci: percentile 95%; sequence-weighted mean after resampling whole user clusters
bootstrap.pairing: shared user resample across model contrast, random control, and all three fixed seeds; jointly eligible windows only

primary_exploratory.contrast: TA2 minus XGBoost directional accuracy at feature k=3
primary_exploratory.sign: class-supporting: positive for malicious / negative for benign
primary_exploratory.secondary: both signs separately and TA2-minus-XGBoost difference of random-control gaps
primary_exploratory.seed_aggregation: equal-seed mean on windows eligible in both models in all 3 seeds; seedwise also reported
primary_exploratory.limitation: primary feature resolution is 13 versus 40 inputs; raw-feature 13-versus-13 sensitivity also reported; exploratory, no superiority claim implied

source_spearman: sum mean |IG| over direct source count/presence channels; shared channels excluded
identifier_rule: U_ + first 10 hex characters of SHA-256(original user ID); raw sequence IDs omitted
